title: Service worker for the app shell
goal: The installed app opens and shows the last snapshot while the hub is unreachable
acceptance: The app shell is cached; API calls are never served from the cache (a test shows it)
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: 1.5 h agent; the hub must serve the worker with the right headers.
